meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: Claude 在分析代码改动或 PR 时，会先确认项目有知识图谱并用 git 列出改动文件，再在图谱中查出对应节点、相连组件、受影响的架构层，最后输出改动范围、影响与风险评估，并生成 diff-overlay.json 供仪表盘使用。
howto.when: 当需要分析 git diff 或 pull request，以弄清改动内容、受影响组件和风险时触发；若项目缺少知识图谱文件，会先提示运行 /understand。

say.text: 分析一下当前未提交的改动会造成什么影响
say.note: 会检查未提交改动并输出影响分析。

say.text: 看看这个 PR 改了什么，会波及哪些模块
say.note: 最好带上 PR 号，会取该 PR 改动并分析波及组件。

say.text: 评估这次代码变更的风险和重点检查处
say.note: 会结合复杂度与影响范围给出风险评估。

howto.what_en: Claude checks the knowledge graph, gets changed files via git, finds matching graph nodes, follows edges to affected components and layers, then provides a structured analysis of changes, impact, risk, and writes diff-overlay.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to analyze a git diff or PR to understand changes, impact, and risks; requires the project knowledge graph, otherwise Claude tells the user to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Analyze the impact of my current uncommitted changes.
say_en.note: Runs impact analysis for uncommitted changes.

say_en.text: What did this PR change and which modules might be affected?
say_en.note: Provide the PR number so it can fetch that PR's diff.

say_en.text: Assess the risk of this code change.
say_en.note: Gives a risk assessment based on complexity and reach.
